title: Marketplace Channel Integration Platform Competitive Landscape

scope.description: Vendors competing with EffectConnect for merchant and brand budgets to connect webshops and back offices to European marketplaces and product feed channels, with focus on the Benelux.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: marketplace integrators and feed-management platforms that EffectConnect's Benelux customers would shortlist. Excluded: marketplaces' own seller tools, pure repricing tools and agencies; Katapull sibling brands; back-office systems with their own marketplace connectors (these are partners or channels).
scope.notes: Figures are company-reported and carry each company's own scope; they are not comparable with each other or with EffectConnect's own claims (50+ European marketplaces). Where no reliable figure was found, no stat is listed.

players.name: ChannelEngine
players.description: Global marketplace integration platform for brands and retailers; acquired Leiden-based Vendiro (70+ marketplaces) in June 2023, consolidating the Dutch integrator market. Main head-to-head competitor in the Benelux.

players.name: Channable
players.description: Feed management and marketplace integration platform for webshops and agencies, strong in product feeds for Google, Meta and comparison sites and expanding into marketplace order connections. Competes with EffectConnect's Feed Manager and marketplace offering. No official company figures captured.

players.name: Lengow
players.description: European e-commerce automation platform combining feed management for advertising channels with marketplace integration.

players.name: Tradebyte
players.description: Zalando-owned commerce platform connecting fashion and lifestyle brands with marketplaces and retailers in DACH and Europe; relevant for brands selling on Zalando and fashion marketplaces. No official figures captured.

players.name: Productsup
players.description: Product-to-consumer (P2C) data platform for feed and marketplace syndication, aimed at larger brands and retailers; overlaps with EffectConnect at the upper end and with brands. No official figures captured.

players.name: Koongo
players.description: Feed and marketplace integration service for SME webshops, also offering a Logic4 connection, which makes it an alternative for Katapull back-office customers.
